name: C²FG (exponential cfg growth)
plain: Scales cfg exponentially as sampling advances: base at high noise, multiplied by exp(g) at the end. Chains with a prior cfg function.
math:
t̃ = (t − t_min)/(t_max − t_min)
s_t = s·exp(g·(1−t̃))
f = u + s_t(c−u), or prior cfg function called with cond_scale=s_t.

providers.author: AbstractEyes
providers.note: w·exp(rate·(1 − t)) with t = σ/(1+σ) (eps models) or flow t, not renormalized to the schedule's own t range; rate default ln 2.

label: from code
surprise: At growth_rate=1 the last step has e≈2.7 times the nominal cfg: the widget is not a blend.
